declarations.name: VeraIcon
declarations.description: An icon: the consumer's own child <svg>, kept byte-identical, or a src rendered as <svg><use href>. Decorative by default (the host gets aria-hidden="true"); with a label the host gets role="img" and aria-label instead. Only a relative src, or http(s) on the page's own origin, is rendered. Size, color and the RTL flip come from the styles layer, by CSS alone.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The icon's accessible name. Set: the host is role="img" with this aria-label. Absent: the icon is decorative (aria-hidden="true").

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: A sprite reference (url#id), rendered as <svg><use href>. Ignored when the icon has a child <svg>. Refused, with a development warning, unless it is relative or http(s) on the page's own origin.

cssParts.name: svg
cssParts.description: The <svg> the icon renders for src (aria-hidden, not focusable). A child <svg> the consumer wrote is theirs, not this part.
